quote: Heal yourself so you can help the world
explanation: We cannot pour from an empty vessel attending to our own mental and emotional health is not selfishness but a prerequisite for meaningful contribution to others.
long_explanation:
Taking care of our mental and emotional health is just as vital as physical well-being. Slowing down helps us stay grounded.

How this connects with our mission:
At Jalte Diye Foundation, our wellness workshops encourage open conversations about mental health, stress management, and mindful living.

Take Action:
Take 5 minutes away from your screen today to practice deep breathing or a quiet walk.
